title: Painting Neuropixels Probes for Electrophysiological Recordings
author: Liu Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wxqffmw

steps.title: Secure Neuropixels Probes
steps.instruction: Secure Neuropixels probes or other silicon probes onto a micromanipulator with the electrode sites facing up.

steps.title: Prepare Microscope Slide and Coverslip
steps.instruction: Secure a microscope slide onto a holder with a clean coverslip attached at the end, positioning the coverslip 2-3 mm from the Neuropixels probe.

steps.title: Apply CM-DiI Dye
steps.instruction: Using a micropipette, place 1 µL of CM-DiI solution (1 µg/µL in ethanol) close to the edge of the coverslip, ensuring no air bubbles are produced in the drop.

steps.title: Paint Probe Tip
steps.instruction: Under a microscope, use the micromanipulator to dip the tip of the Neuropixels probe into the dye within 30 seconds of application.

substeps.instruction: Ensure dye does not touch the electrode sites.
Note that for Neuropixels probes, the tip extends approximately 150 µm from the first electrode site.

steps.title: Dry the Dye
steps.instruction: Wait approximately 30 seconds for the ethanol to evaporate and the CM-DiI dye to dry onto the probe tip.

steps.title: Retract and Verify Probe
steps.instruction: Slowly retract the probe away from the coverslip using the micromanipulator and dismount.

substeps.instruction: Verify that dried pink dye is visible on the tip of the probe.
Repeat the painting process if no dye is visible.
